thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — following up on the eviction / reclaimed token handshake we prototyped. Observed cases where soft-evict didn't free credits for >30s.
Trent Wu: Seen that in perf tests. Looks like ProbeService holds references during retry backoff.
Samira Ortiz: Can we push reclamation as an explicit post-evict message to the quota-broker? That would avoid GC timing.
Li Chen: +1. But we need idempotency. Proposed message: `RECLAIM tenant_id lease_id seq` and broker stores last_seq per-tenant.
Maya Patel: Implementation sketch:
```
POST /quota/reclaim HTTP/1.1
Host: quota-broker.internal
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tenant": "t-123",
  "lease_id": "l-456",
  "seq": 42
}
```
Trent Wu: Make sure we don't double-count when reclaim arrives after auto-refill. Add `if seq <= last_seq return 200` logic.
Samira Ortiz: Also need backoff window to avoid thundering reclaim storms during widespread evictions. Circuit breaker on broker side.
Li Chen: Telemetry: emit `reclaim_received`, `reclaim_accepted`, `reclaim_ignored` with tenant, lease_id, latency.
OpsBot: Synthetic test run queued: reclaim-storm-1000 in staging.
Maya Patel: Decision? If no objections, I'll open RFC PR linking quota-broker idempotency and eviction sidecar changes. Action: Maya to draft, Trent to review, Samira to handle telem.
Trent Wu: OK. One more: add graceful fallback where if reclaim fails, eviction marks tenant as `probation` for 60s rather than aborting.
Samira Ortiz: SGTM :thumbsup:
Li Chen: I'll add seq schema and small proto change. ETA EOD.
Maya Patel: Thanks — will track in the RFC. /cc @eng-infra for rollout window.
